info.text:
Google just locked in nuclear power for 20 years.
On Oct 6, 2026, Google and Constellation Energy announced a 20-year deal for 890 MW of new nuclear power from upgrades (uprates) at 11 existing reactors.
Constellation is investing over $4.3 billion; the first uprate is expected by 2028, all 890 MW by 2032.
Same day, the US Energy Department made a conditional commitment to lend Vistra up to $4.2 billion for its nuclear plants. Constellation stock rose about 12% on Oct 6.
Sources: Google, Constellation, US Dept. of Energy, Utility Dive, ANS.
News and education, not financial advice.
